meta.name: browser
meta.description: Lightweight browser automation using Puppeteer Core. Connect to running Chrome via remote debugging for fast screenshots, JS evaluation, element picking, and authenticated scraping. Token-efficient alternative to heavy MCP servers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动浏览器自动截屏与抓取数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用代码自动操作浏览器完成网页截图或取数
copy.tagline_en: Drive a running Chrome browser for automated screenshots and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automate browser actions like screenshots and data extraction

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能操控 Chrome 浏览器：打开网页、截图、执行 JavaScript 等，并可用于抓取数据。
howto.when: 当你提出“打开网页”“截图”“抓取页面信息”等浏览器操作需求时，此技能会启动或连接 Chrome 来执行。

say.text: 帮我把当前网页截图存下来。
say.note: 会调用截图命令，生成图片文件。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com，然后统计页面上的链接数量。
say.note: 会先导航，再用 JavaScript 计算链接数。

say.text: 用我的登录状态抓取 GitHub 首页的仓库列表。
say.note: 会带个人资料启动 Chrome，再抓取。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude control a Chrome browser: open URLs, take screenshots, run JavaScript, etc., and can be used for scraping.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to open a webpage, take a screenshot, or scrape page content, etc. It starts or connects to Chrome to carry out the task.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page.
say_en.note: Runs the screenshot command to save an image.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and count the links.
say_en.note: Navigates then evaluates JS to count links.

say_en.text: Scrape the repo list from GitHub using my logged-in session.
say_en.note: Starts Chrome with your profile and extracts data.
